name: Music For Programming
summary: Series of 79 mixes by different artists, intended for listening while programming to focus the brain.
description: A numbered series of mixes by different artists, made for listening while programming to focus the brain and inspire the mind. 79 episodes so far, from ~30-minute sets to 4-hour marathons, each tagged Electronic, Ambient, Acoustic, Drone, Noise or Instrumental. Episodes stream in the browser player or via the RSS feed with direct mp3 links.
contains: each episode credited to a different artist (Datassette, Hainbach, Com Truise …)
episode lengths from ~30 minutes to 4 hours
episode tags: Electronic, Ambient, Acoustic, Drone, Noise, Instrumental, Study, Concentration, Programming
RSS feed with direct mp3 links (files hosted at datashat.net)
